messages:
Lena Ortiz: Announcing a limited preview for Onprem Privacy Guard (OPG) — a privacy-forward config bundle for Private/VPC installs. Pilot next week for a small set of customers.

Samir Shah: TL;DR of changes?

Lena Ortiz: Key defaults: strict egress by default, telemetry-minimization toggle, KMS-only immutable audit snapshots, and an attestations API for compliance proofs. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/opg-preview (internal).

Priya Kapoor (Legal): For external comms avoid absolute claims like 'we delete'. Use: 'customers control telemetry retention and export.' Also need final dataflow diagrams before we go public.

Dina Cho (Support): Migration notes? required downtime?

Kai Müller (Platform): Online migration with a 48-72h validation window. No full agent restart required; first snapshot handshake may take ~30s if KMS is configured. Rollback = console toggle + health-check auto-revert.

Samir Shah: Ops checklist snippet for pilots:
```
opg:
  egressDefault: deny
  telemetry:
    mode: minimization
  audit:
    snapshots: immutable
    retentionDays: 90
```

DeployBot: deploy: opg-preview v1.0 -> staging :white_check_mark: (3m 45s)

Lena Ortiz: Action items: platform validate staging (Kai), legal finalize wording & diagrams (Priya), support prep playbook (Dina). Ping me with pilot customer names. We'll publish KB + FAQ after legal sign-off. :lock:
